name: Worldgen v0.8 Object Outliner + Footprint Editing
cargoCheckReason: cargo is not installed in this container
features: Objects tab now has a scene-object outliner alongside object placement tools
Placed objects can be selected from the outliner or picked from the cursor cell
Selected object visual/collision footprints are highlighted in the scene overlay
Selected objects can be nudged by arrow keys or moved to the cursor anchor
Move operations validate against multi-tile collision/interaction footprint rules before committing
Selected objects can be deleted with the Delete button, Delete key, or Backspace key
